हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description:
A genius software engineer gives up his career to work as the secretary of the woman he loves.
For years, he supports her quietly, hoping she will choose him one day.
But when her past love returns, everything is at risk.
